thread:
deploy-bot: Initiating staged feature-flag rollout 'ranker_v2_lockstep' across traffic slices. Plan: canary=1% -> cohort-A=10% -> cohort-B=30% -> global=100%. Hold 5m between steps. Routing: header-slicing via X-Route:ranker.

aditya: pinning model to v2.4.1 for the rollout. will also add a fallback to v2.3.9.
mia: copy that. ramp steps + hold ok. can we add a quick smoke that checks rerank stability before each step? :eyes:

deploy-bot: Smoke check available: `/run smoke ranker_v2 --checks=latency,topk_stability,rank_score_delta --thresholds=latency:120ms,score_delta:0.05`
sam: QA ran preliminary smoke on staging, saw a tiny reorder on a tail query set (mostly low traffic). not blocking but callout: rerank for long prompts degrades.
aditya: noted. push a stricter gating on the canary: require topk_stability >= 0.98. Mia, ok?
mia: yup do that. also set automatic rollback if error_rate > 3% sustained for 5m OR p50 latency +30% vs baseline for 5m.
sre_jen: please also alert on host memory >= 90% in the cohort cluster — last time we hit out-of-memory during warmup.
ops-bot: telemetry hook configured: alerts -> #eng-oncall, threshold triggers: error_rate=3.0%, p50_increase=30%, host_mem=90%.
product_liz: track downstream metrics too: CTR of top suggestion and session length. if CTR drops >2% across cohort we pause.
kevin: rollback plan ready: `git revert --no-edit 7a1c9f3 && /deploy rollback ranker_v2 --to-model=v2.3.9` commit 7a1c9f3 contains the ranker change. ops runbook updated.

deploy-bot: Canary step (1%) started at 1768009999. cohort id: c-0123.
ops-bot: canary telemetry snapshot: error_rate=0.8%, p50_latency_change=+6%, host_mem=72%. all green so far.

(5m later)
ops-bot: canary smoke result: topk_stability=0.987 (below 0.98 gate). slight reorder edgecases in long prompts.
aditya: pausing ramp — holding at canary. tagging @sam to triage the long-prompt reorders.
sam: looking. found model tokenization mismatch on edge cases; pushing hotfix branch `fix/tokenize-long-prompts`. rough patch ready for QA.
mia: leave flag at 1% until we confirm fix. we will not move to cohort-A.

(ops-bot posts): alert: error_rate spike on canary host host-12: 4.2% (5m rolling). memory on host-12 at 98%. :rotating_light:
sre_jen: immediate stop and drain host-12, move canary traffic off host-12, demote host from LB pool.
kevin: executing drain: `/infra drain host-12 --reason=canary-mem-spike`
ops-bot: drain started. canary traffic redistributed across c-0123 nodes.
aditya: given the memory spike + smoke fail, full rollback not needed but we will keep canary at 0% until fix validated. setting manual hold.

(10m later)
sam: patch: `fix/tokenize-long-prompts` merged to canary images, smoke re-run queued.
deploy-bot: smoke re-run result: topk_stability=0.994, latency change p50=+4%. gates passed.
mia: ok to proceed? recommend small step to cohort-A = 10% with a 10m hold.
aditya: approve. update rollout command:```/deploy --ff=ranker_v2_lockstep --steps=1,10,30,100 --holds=5m,10m,10m,10m --gate=smoke,alerts```
product_liz: noted. Runbook: notify growth to watch CTR for first 20m of cohort-A.
sre_jen: oncall watching. set alert escalation to page after 2m if error_rate > 2% in cohort-A.

deploy-bot: cohort-A ramp to 10% started at 1768010200.
ops-bot: cohort-A telemetry initial: error_rate=0.9%, p50_latency_change=+5%, host_mem avg=70%.

(after 12m)
ops-bot: cohort-A stable for 12m. no alerts. CTR within ±0.3%.
aditya: continue to cohort-B (30%). keep same holds.
mia: will monitor. performing additional traffic-slice checks for header routing (X-Route:ranker).

(final)
deploy-bot: rollout completed to 100% at 1768010520. All gates green.
product_liz: nice, thanks team. retrospective item: add tokenization edgecase smoke to preflight pipeline and add a memory warmup check for canary hosts.
aditya: filing ticket now. thanks for quick triage everyone. :tada:
